grammar.industry_rule: Every thesis section opens with who in the market is already moving — then why the form still misses.
grammar.landscape_rule: Map before you score: layers table or scatter must precede the Margin of Safety argument.
grammar.mechanics_rule: Technical content serves the proposal — E×P frame, interruption ≠ damage, evidence tiers; stop before the full case.
grammar.proposal_rule: Three claims + one instrument; close on whitespace and who can carry unrated availability exposure.
grammar.viz_rule: Scatter follows Act II landscape prose; rankings follow Act IV proposal.
grammar.honest_provisional: State PROVISIONAL/measured share once at data handoff
